name: Borobudur
blurb: Borobudur is a 9th-century Mahayana Buddhist temple located in Central Java, Indonesia, recognized as the largest Buddhist temple in the world. The UNESCO World Heritage site features extensive bas-reliefs and is frequently visited alongside the Prambanan temple.

positive: Great experiences seeing the sunrise and surrounding landscape
Fascinating historical reliefs and cultural depth
negative: Concerns regarding older photos looking dated or lower quality
Debates over authenticity and conservation proposals like the Chattra
